depth.primary: 0 4px 0 pressed-blue, collapsing to 0 1px 0 + translateY(3px) on press
depth.tile: soft two-layer standing shadow (--depth-tile) on interactive tiles
depth.arcade: Atlas scope-selection exception (Home continent list, continent region list, region domain-play grid): 2px solid text-colour border + 2px 2px 0 hard offset shadow, collapsing via diagonal translate(2px, 2px) on press. Domain launchers reached after a domain is chosen keep the soft tile depth.

principles: Geography is the content; interface is the instrument
Atlas Blue drives ordinary action while green and red stay transient feedback
Region-by-domain mastery is purple; gold is deliberately scarce
Complete continents earn source-derived silhouette crests; world completion alone earns the Crown
Country records are live learning evidence, not prestige objects
Progress is mastery-first: continent and region achievement geography precedes practise guidance, progressively disclosed country evidence, and reset utilities

Earned region-domain competency uses the shared domain glyph with a non-colour check cue; complete regions use restrained gold; unsupported curriculum is visually distinct from unearned supported competency
The World Crown is absent from routine locked states and rendered only when canonical world completion is earned
Mobile-first interaction and no horizontal scrolling for primary selection
Radius, depth, typography, navigation composition and milestone scarcity remain locked as Tactile Atlas
Navigation is scope-first: Home lists continents, a continent lists regions, and region surfaces expose the domain entry points without changing durable typed routes
